dialectic_sweep: Parent-derived environment identity appears deterministic but is false when the child interpreter or environment differs; authenticated child self-attestation resolves that contradiction.
Hashing distribution metadata is useful identity but is not proof of installed payload bytes; exact-closure admission therefore fails closed.
A pure propose-and-grade function is not RSI without an independent evaluator, authenticated promotion authority, canary and rollback control, a deployed consumer, and outcome learning.

Maintenance RSI is real because generation repair, immutable replica verification, route activation, and post-query unchanged-digest proof operate today. Retrieval-quality RSI remains non-operational because its promotion-and-learning loop is absent.
first_principles: A-grade is an evidence-backed admission result, never a label attached to incomplete runtime identity.
Runtime evidence must bind the executable child, exact source closure, replica closure, model closure, environment inputs, runtime knobs, and installed dependency payload bytes.
Scalable repeated retrieval requires an immutable activation descriptor and a resident authenticated owner; per-query environment-tree hashing is rejected.
The extension remains a thin read-only consumer and gains no repository mutation, reindex, maintenance, worker-dispatch, or promotion authority from this transaction.
